_comment: Groups the org's repos for the landing page. `feature` drives the bento at the top of The work; the first entry spans four columns, the rest two each. Everything else renders as compact rows under its group heading. New nests belong in the `nests` group, not left to fall through. Repos not listed in any group land in 'Also in the org'. `hide` keeps a repo off entirely.

groups.blurb: The engine, its catalogue of nests, and the pieces that sit around it.

groups.blurb: Prebuilt indexing definitions for the protocol's own data. Point nuthatch at one and it self-hosts what a rented subgraph used to serve.

groups.blurb: The same, for the contracts everyone else actually queries. One binary per nest, no subgraph deployment.
